$comment: Council of Minds is a ROUTER over two co-equal chambers. This file holds ROUTER/GLOBAL configuration only: the neutral 'chambers' routing map, decision-chamber 'modes', and cross-chamber behaviour tables (costBudget, interactiveMode, enforcement). Each chamber's cast lives in its own file: the DECISION chamber in settings/decision-council.config.json, the RESEARCH chamber in settings/research-council.config.json.

chambers.$comment: Neutral routing map. Both chambers are peers; neither is subordinate. The orchestrator (council-of-minds.md, Routing / Chamber Selection) classifies each request to one of these.

chain.$comment: Phase 20 (v4.1). Compound questions ('what's the best X given the current landscape') run the Research chamber FIRST, then feed its Research Verdict into the Decision chamber as the evidence base. Dissent is preserved at BOTH layers. See council-of-minds.md '## Chamber Chaining' and docs/chamber-chaining.md.
detect: asks what to DO but the choice depends on a current/sourced state of the world
a decision request that names recency terms or an unsettled factual premise

handoff.$comment: The research verdict is handed to the decision panel with source identity intact so advisors can cite it and contest it.
payload: Findings Cards (claim, evidence type, confidence, stance)
handoff.rule: advisors receive Findings Cards WITH source ids; they may cite a finding by id and may contest it, but must not silently discard a contested finding

crossReference.decisionVerdict: adds a 'Sourced-From' field naming the research verdict id
crossReference.researchVerdict: retained verbatim as the evidence appendix of the chained output

reEntry.$comment: Advisors may find the evidence base insufficient for a specific gap.
reEntry.effect: the named gap re-enters the Research chamber as a new sub-question
reEntry.why: bounded to 1 to prevent research<->decision ping-pong loops

chain.dissent: preserve BOTH the research Minority Report and the decision Minority Report in the final chained output; never collapse them

budget.$comment: One tier applies across BOTH chambers using the shared vocabulary (Minimal/Lean/Standard/High/Deep/Unlimited).
budget.rule: the selected tier configures the research chamber (retrieval dimensions) AND the decision chamber (panel/mode/word limits) in the same run

research.$comment: Research chamber (v4.0), a co-equal peer routed via the top-level 'chambers' map. Full spec in settings/research-council.config.json and the Research Council section of council-of-minds.md. Referenced here only so the mode name resolves within this file.

interactiveMode.description: When true, all council sessions include checkpoints. When false (default), only triggered by 'interactive council:' or 'council this with checkpoints:'
